activity.notes: Khosrow II first acceded in 590 but lost the throne during Bahrām Chōbin's usurpation. ATLAS preserves this first reign as a separate 590 Activity rather than merging the interruption into a continuous 590–628 rail.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Iranica — ḴOSROW II
sources.citation_text: Encyclopaedia Iranica identifies Khosrow II as Sasanian king and describes his loss and recovery of the throne after the 590 accession.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Iranica — Chronology of Iranian History, Part 1
sources.citation_text: Iranica's chronology records Khosrow II's accession in 590, Bahrām Chōbin's seizure of power in 590, and Khosrow's restoration in 591.
